import matplotlib.patheffects as pe

cars = source['cars']['data']
dims = source['cars']['dimensions']
dim_labels = [
    'Price\n(Affordability)', 'Fuel\nEfficiency', 'Power', 'Safety',
    'Interior\nSpace', 'Resale\nValue', 'Emission\nRating'
]

    'SUV':      '#1B6B93',

}
type_order = ['SUV', 'Sedan', 'Electric']

# Find top performer on each axis
top_per_axis = {}
for dim in dims:
    best_car = max(cars, key=lambda c: c[dim])
    top_per_axis[dim] = best_car['model']

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(18, 10), dpi=150)
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#F8F9FA')
ax.set_facecolor('#F8F9FA')

n_dims = len(dims)

    for vtype in type_order:

        lo, hi = min(vals), max(vals)
        rect = plt.Rectangle(
            (i - 0.12 + type_order.index(vtype) * 0.08, lo),
            0.08, hi - lo,
            facecolor=type_colors[vtype], alpha=0.10, edgecolor='none', zorder=1
        )
        ax.add_patch(rect)

# Draw vertical axis lines
for i in range(n_dims):
    ax.axvline(x=i, color='#BBBBBB', linewidth=1.0, zorder=2)

# Draw tick marks on each axis
for i in range(n_dims):
    for val in [0, 25, 50, 75, 100]:
        ax.plot([i - 0.03, i + 0.03], [val, val], color='#999999', linewidth=0.7, zorder=2)
        if i == 0:
            ax.text(i - 0.10, val, str(val), ha='right', va='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#555555')

# Draw polylines
for vtype in type_order:
    type_cars = [c for c in cars if c['type'] == vtype]
    color = type_colors[vtype]
    for car in type_cars:
        vals = [car[d] for d in dims]
        is_top = car['model'] in top_per_axis.values()

        if is_top:
            line.set_path_effects([
                pe.Stroke(linewidth=lw + 1.5, foreground='white', alpha=0.6),
                pe.Normal()
            ])

# Mark top performers with star markers and labels

for i, dim in enumerate(dims):
    best_car = [c for c in cars if c['model'] == top_per_axis[dim]][0]
    val = best_car[dim]
    color = type_colors[best_car['type']]

    ax.plot(i, val, marker='*', markersize=16, color=color, markeredgecolor='#222222',
            markeredgewidth=0.9, zorder=9)

        ha = 'left'

        xy=(i, val), xytext=(0, offset_y),
        textcoords='offset points', ha=ha, va='bottom',
        fontsize=7, fontweight='bold', color='#1A1A1A',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.25', facecolor='white', edgecolor=color,
                  alpha=0.92, linewidth=1.0),
        zorder=10
    )
    labeled_positions.append((i, val + offset_y))

# Axis labels at bottom
for i, label in enumerate(dim_labels):
    ax.text(i, -10, label, ha='center', va='top', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', color='#2A2A2A')

# Title
ax.text(

    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#8B4513', lw=1.2),
    zorder=8
)
ax.text(
    1.5, 15,
    'Trade-off zone: High power ↔ Low fuel efficiency\n(frequent line crossings between these axes)',
    ha='center', va='top', fontsize=7.5, fontstyle='italic', color='#6B3410',
    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.35', facecolor='#FFF5EB', edgecolor='#C9956B', alpha=0.92),
    zorder=8
)

# Annotation about price vs resale
ax.annotate(
    '',

    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#4A6B8A', lw=1.2),

# Legend
